title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector R – Map, Plots & Prices
description: Explore Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector R with map guidance, current plot sizes, price factors, development checks, availability and buyer verification.
intro:
Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector R is an active residential sector within FT-II, with current market listings showing available plots and R-sector references such as R-1.

Buyers usually compare Sector R by plot size, exact map position, current development, payment status and total payable amount. Because inventory is still limited, verify the exact plot and written terms before making a decision.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector R overview

Sector R is part of Faisal Town Phase 2 and appears in current market inventory as a residential sector with active plot listings.

Some listings also use more specific references such as R-1 or informal wording such as R Block.

For clarity, this page uses the Phase 2 terminology Sector R.

When considering a property here, verify the exact plot number, sub-area reference, road position, payment status and current development rather than relying only on the sector name.

## Sector R location and map

Use the Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan to identify Sector R within the wider project.

If a dedicated Sector R plan is not available, ask the seller or agent for a marked map showing:

- exact plot number
- R-sector sub-area
- street or road
- nearby boulevard
- surrounding sectors
- access route
- nearby development

A current market listing for a 5-marla plot uses an R-1 reference together with a specific plot number, which shows why plot-level identification matters. 

Do not rely only on a general “Sector R” label when comparing two properties.

## R-1 and other Sector R references

Some market listings use R-1 terminology within Sector R.

Treat that sub-area label as a location clue, not as final proof of the property's exact status.

If an advertisement says R-1, ask for:

- plot number
- map position
- plot size
- road width
- dues status
- development status
- possession status, if claimed
- payment completion

Keep Sector R as the main page rather than creating separate thin R-1 pages unless there is enough verified information to justify them.

## Plot sizes in Sector R

Current listings show at least smaller residential plots in Sector R, including 5 marla / approximately 25 x 50 inventory.

The wider Faisal Town Phase 2 market also includes sizes such as:

- 5 or 5.56 marla
- 8 marla
- 10 marla
- 1 kanal
- 2 kanal

However, do not assume that every size is available in Sector R under the same terms.

Verify the exact dimensions from the property documents and current inventory.

## Sector R plots for sale

Sector R has active market inventory, although the number of current listings appears lower than in some other Phase 2 sectors.

That makes live verification especially important.

Before comparing two Sector R listings, establish whether each one is:

- a numbered plot
- fresh booking inventory
- fully paid
- partially paid
- resale inventory
- carrying outstanding dues
- carrying development or possession charges

A lower headline price may not be cheaper once unpaid charges are added.

## Sector R prices

There is no single reliable price for all Sector R plots.

Recent market data shows Sector R inventory at a higher average asking level than some other Phase 2 sectors, but the number of listings is currently small, so this should be treated only as a rough market signal. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

Current asking prices can vary because of:

- plot size
- R-sector sub-area
- exact road or street
- corner position
- main-road location
- development
- possession
- payment completion
- outstanding dues
- seller urgency
- current demand

For this reason, compare like-for-like plots rather than publishing one fixed “Sector R price.”

## Example of current Sector R inventory

A recent Sector R / R-1 listing advertised a 5-marla, 25 x 50 residential plot with a specific plot number and an asking price around PKR 2.6 million.

Use examples like this only as a dated market reference.

Do not treat one advertisement as the sector's official price or guaranteed market value. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

## Sector R development and access

Development should be checked for the exact plot location.

When visiting Sector R, inspect:

- road formation
- street marking
- drainage work
- utility infrastructure
- plot demarcation
- surrounding construction
- machinery or active development
- access from major Phase 2 roads

If a seller claims that possession or utilities are available, ask for current supporting documentation for the exact property.

## Sector R payment checks

Before paying anything, request a written breakdown showing:

- agreed plot price
- amount already paid
- outstanding balance
- remaining installments
- development charges
- possession charges
- location premium
- transfer charges
- taxes
- total payable amount

If the listing is resale inventory, confirm whether any dues remain with the developer.

## How Sector R compares with Sector O and Sector P

Sector R should be compared with Sector O and Sector P using the same criteria.

Compare:

- plot size
- exact location
- current asking price
- payment status
- total payable cost
- development
- access
- resale supply

Sector P currently has a clearer published price schedule, while Sector O has stronger Model Block positioning.

Sector R should therefore be evaluated on its own current inventory rather than assuming it follows either Sector P or Sector O pricing.

## Who Sector R may suit

Sector R may suit buyers who are comparing current Phase 2 residential inventory and want to evaluate an identifiable plot based on location and total cost.

It may be relevant for:

- buyers seeking a specific R-sector location
- investors comparing current Phase 2 entry prices
- buyers willing to verify lower-volume resale inventory carefully
- purchasers focused on individual plot position rather than branding

It may be less suitable for someone who wants a sector with a clearly published current price table or a large amount of readily comparable inventory.

## Is Sector R good for investment?

Sector R may be considered as part of a broader Faisal Town Phase 2 comparison, but the individual property matters more than the sector label.

Before buying for investment, compare:

- entry price
- exact plot location
- road position
- development
- outstanding dues
- resale demand
- competing listings
- likely holding period
- total acquisition cost

Avoid making a decision from one portal listing or one quoted dealer price.

## Sector R site-visit checklist

Before making an offer, confirm the plot on the map and visit the location where possible.

Check:

- plot number
- R-sector or R-1 reference
- road width
- access
- ground level
- surrounding development
- drainage
- corner or special location
- nearby construction
- practical route from major access points

For remote buyers, request a live video walkthrough and a marked map for the exact property.

## Do not confuse Sector R with Phase 1 block naming

Sector R on this page refers specifically to Faisal Town Phase 2.

Some market listings may use phrases such as “R Block,” but this should not be confused with Faisal Town Phase 1 block pages.

Always ask for:

- project phase
- exact sector
- plot number
- map reference

before comparing prices or paying a token.
